note: 3.8, rev 00088. A RESCHEDULE, the worst tool in the corpus at 38% abandonment, and the SECOND firing of write_order_gate_ceiling. Also the cleanest closing sequence recorded: completion, then the ask, then the goodbye, in three separate turns.

turns.caller: I just want to check if I have any appointments.
turns.assistant: You have an appointment booked for Wednesday, September 23rd at 2:00 PM.
Of course. What day and time would you prefer to move your appointment to?
Our office is closed on Sundays. Would you like to look at a weekday instead?
On Monday, we have openings at 9:00 AM, 1:00 PM, and 4:30 PM. Which of those times works best for you?
On Wednesday, September 23rd, we have openings at 9:00 AM, 12:30 PM, and 4:30 PM. Do any of those work for you?
Just to confirm, I'll move your appointment to Wednesday, September 23rd at 12:30 PM. Shall I go ahead with that?
That's all set. Your appointment is now confirmed for Wednesday, September 23rd at 12:30 PM.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling Digile Media. Have a great day.

attempts.why: fired the moment the caller named a day, with nothing read back and nothing agreed.
